initial_test_failure.reason: Test assertions incorrectly equated eighty synthetic physical tracks with the number of search maxima. Measured output had ninety-seven NMS maxima; thirty physical tracks were lost at the fifty-candidate cap.
initial_test_failure.correction: Keep physical-signal matching separate from candidate-count arithmetic. Production detector and experiment parameters were not tuned to make tests pass.

source_access_failures.outcome: redirect loop; direct HTTP client subsequently retrieved portal and documented API route
primary record unavailable via connector; not used as empirical evidence

resolution_product_check.finding: An exact archive index timestamp can refer to a high-time-resolution product. Inspecting original HDF5 attributes resolved the high-frequency-resolution product; timestamp/index metadata alone was not accepted as source proof.

unchanged_scientific_method: Immutable original baseline; all additions are in research/pilot. No LLM or new origin classifier.

range_io_optimization.issue: Fixed 2 MiB blocks amplified small scattered HDF5 metadata reads. Two initial retrieval processes overlapped during a restart; both stopped before resumption.
range_io_optimization.integrity_action: All indexed cache blocks were hash-verified; three unindexed blocks were quarantined and not reused. See cache_restart_audit.json.
range_io_optimization.correction: OS single-writer process lock; atomic cache-manifest writes; 64 KiB metadata blocks; coalesced concurrent data prefetch; reuse of larger verified cache intervals.; thread-local persistent TLS-verified HTTPS sessions to reduce connection latency.
range_io_optimization.measurement_limit: Successful-run network byte counts exclude prior interrupted/repeated transfer traffic.
range_io_optimization.successful_partial_checks: First two source excerpts matched release; remaining source checks awaited before completion status.

source_sample_validation.outcome: All six original high-frequency-resolution excerpts match release arrays in dtype, shape and every float32 value.
source_sample_validation.scope: All stored integrations over one selected 4096-channel interval; no full-band or whole-file MD5 claim.
source_sample_validation.source_resolution_mismatch_resolved: The .gpuspec.0000.h5 product matches released header resolution/time exactly; matching only archive-index timestamps would have selected the wrong product.
source_sample_validation.timeout_history: An earlier extraction completed five scans and recorded one read timeout. That output was retained as archive_excerpts_incomplete_timeout.json. A bounded-retry cached resume completed the sixth.
